author: Joris Goosen <Joris@JorisGoosen.nl>
commit message:
Kill! Kill! Kill! (#4090)

* If the engine takes too long to pause just kill it instead of crashing the entire GUI
- implements https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/875
- Small tweak to also kill the engine if it doesnt respond to a stopRequest
- Implemented a "abort analysis if no response" on option changes
- Make sure engines pause gracefully and do not kill the desktop for each little unexpected reply.
-- Some of them are unexpected but not that bad, so it is nice to be able to differentiate those errors from others (new exception added)
- Added an exception to enumutilities to be able to catch the "missing enum val problem" specifically (aka entered a string that isnt an enumval)
- Resume engine now also sends the settings, this avoids another send->reply cycle afterwards
- Split the filter pause-resume from running the filter so that a process loop can be made in between and let the desktop possibly respond to something
- Engine now also reads in columnnames on startup, because maybe it just started after being killed (or just plain crashing ofc)
- We might be on a killing spree but it would be nice if the desktop also responds well to an engine that *does* respond properly to option changes.
-- For this Ive added a KeepStatus Analysis::Status that tells the Analysis it should, well duh, keep it's current status instead of changing it to something new.
- Taken some code for ~MainWindow from stablish branch that destroys all the loaded qml in reverse order
-- this should avoid a bunch of qml warnings/errors were the qml was dependent on other objects that are already deleted by MainWindow
- If the analysis is aborted by killing on an optionchange we refresh it to make sure we do not get any half-written files, I think this is unlikely but not impossible so it is good to aboid it entirely.
- Also added a cleanUpAfterClose() on EngineRepresentation because otherwise some info might be stuck there after closing a workspace.

* Wait a bit long before killing and log it when you do.

* So, we also accept an engine as paused when it is still initializing
- Otherwise it kills the engines on startup if it takes a while

commit message:
Integer Field shows wrong error

Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/2076

When an IntegerField (or a DoubleFiled) has a constraint (min or max for example), the control may show sometimes a red border as if it has wrong value, even if the value is OK.
This is due to a wrong fix made some time ago that activate this red border for controls that have wrong default value. This was done by assigning a width and a color to the focus indicator when the control was still initializing. This is wrong since the control get then wrong default values for its width and color border.
The check whether the control has wrong default value must be dome just after iti is initialized.

commit message:
The source of a Dropdown should be fetched before its value is set when reading a JASP file

Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-test-release/issues/1780
This solves 2 problems:
. a dropdown with a source is not set properly when a JASP file is read: if the dropdown was set with a value coming from the source, when reading the JASP file, if the values of the source are not yet read, setting the dropdown generates an error. This is the case in the ANOVA analysis: the 'Reference model for weight ratios' dropdown in the Order Restriction, has for source the titles of the tabs of the Order Restriction models. If the dropdown is set with one of these values, reading a JASP file with this setting will lead to an error.
. if an error is set to a control, removing this error lets the analysis is an error state, and the analysis cannot run anymore.

In AnalysisForm, the terms of an available model (which is the case for a dropdown) should be fetched before the value of the dropdown is set.
Also remove the _getControlErrorMessageOfControl method which is not used anymore.
In ControlErrorMessage, when the message is closed, its association with its control should be removed: in this way the AnalysisForm::hasError becomes false.

commit message:
examples for plot builder

**Scatter plot**

This data set, "Big Five Personality Traits", provides scores of 500 participants on a Big Five personality questionnaire.

The example shows how to use the Plot builder module to create a scatter plot with *p* value.

**Repeates measures plot**

This data set, "Weight Gain", provides weights of 16 participants before and after an eight-week period of excessive calorie intake.

The example shows how to use the Plot builder module to create repeated measurements plots.

**Boxplot**

The data set contains 150 observations of three iris flower types: Setosa, Versicolor, and Virginica. Four features were measured from each flower in the data: the length and the width of the sepals and petals, in centimeters.

The example shows how to use the Plot builder module to create boxplots with p values.

**Plot layout**

This example demonstrates how to create a clear and well-structured plot layout using the Plot Builder, based on penguin data collected by scientists between 2007 and 2009 from three islands in the Palmer Archipelago in Antarctica.

commit message:
Workspace emptyvalues must have default values

When loading a 0.18.1 JASP file, the workspace default values are empty.
They should be set to the preferences empty values as default (since there is no workspace empty values in 0.18.1).
In DataSet::setEmptyValuesJson, there was already an handling to overcome this issue, but as DataSet has no access to the PreferencesModel object, it was depending of setting the _defaultEmptyvalues property just after the DataSet was created. But as DataSet might be deleted and created several times, the _defaultEmptyvalues is not always set. So just make it a static property, so that it just has to be set once.

Beter handling of Selection. mouse click and right-click behaviour on the Data view (#5134)

* Beter handling of Selection. mouse click and right-click behaviour on the Data view

In the DataView, different issues have been solved:
. Select a cell, right click on another cell: the selected cell should be unselected, and the pop-up menu should appear
. Select some cells, right-click on one of these cells: the selected cells should stay selected, and the pop-uo menu shoulp appear. A right-click on an unselected cell should unselect the selected cells, select the new cell, and the pop-up menu should appear. A simple click (on a selected cell or not) unselect the other cells, and select the current cell, and this cell gets the focus.
. Click on a row header: the whole row should be selected. Click on one cell (selected or not), the row is unselected, only the current cell is selected and has the focus. Right click on a selected cell: the row stays selected, and a pop-up menu appears on the clicked cell. Right -click on a unselected cell, the row is unselected and a pop-up menu appears on the clicked cell.
. Click on a row header and shift-click on another row header: all the rows between the 2 rows shoudl be selected. Same behaviour as with only one row selected.. If delete row is selected from the pop-up menu or from the ribbon menu: all the selected rows should be removed.
. Same behaviour with column header

commit message:
Still a problem when Radiobuttons are created and deleted dynamically

Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-test-release/issues/2911

The RadioButtons are in a TabView. If one tab is removed, the radio buttons are removed: if a radio button is removed before the radio button group is removed, this could provoke an update of the options (the Tab which is deleted, gets a signal to update its option). To tackle this, in the rowControl which contains the controls of the Tab, we call all its controls to be unitialized before deleting them (the blockSignals is not enough since the Radio button can call the Radio Button group without having to use signals).

commit message:
Use of VariablesForm inside a TabView does not work (#4486)

* Use of VariablesForm inside a TabView does not work

This is due to the initialisation of dynamic controls. They should not
be setup immediately when they are created, but when all dynamic
controls are created: when there are some dependencies between some
controls, they can then refer to each other being sure that they are
already created.
The VariablesForm is set as a JASPControl, so that we can beter control
when its initialisation starts: this initialisation sets the
relationships between the VariablesList inside the form, and those
relationships must be set before the VariablesLists self start their
setup.

* Forgot these files

* Add beter comment for the sort algorithm of the controls.

- Fix module request tryCatch thing
- Use checksums magic for avoiding reinstalling jasp* pkgs

- Current R version should be a string not a double

Some MacOS stuff:
makedmg.sh changes for renv
- it should copy renv-cache
- It should replace all absolute symlinks in the build-folder/Modules by relative links to renv-cache
- it should remove BH https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/1285
- handling the symlinks is done in the new symlinkTools.R
-- it can collect all absolute symlinks in a data.frame (tested only on mac for now)
-- it can also use this data.frame to replace them all by their relative variants. (will probably break if the symlinks do not point to renv-cache btw)
-- call it from make-dmg.sh before copying

Some Windows stuff:
- windows symlinkTools.R script can now store junctions relatively in junctions.rds and another function can restore the entire Modules folder from that
- JASP and JASPEngine should be capable of running symlinkTools.R to collect junctions
- Paths should be under 260 chars otherwise WIX/light chokes, so follow path with ../.. to shave some chars off
- Copying *all* contents of jasp* pkgs is important
- Takeaway is that the installer now restores the modules-junctions. Zip should do this as well, but then on startup

- JAGS is now broken on Mac, see https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/1345
- Language files stuff has been removed because we dont need it anymore

Stuff since opening PR:
- more logging on module request
- Copy both symlinkTools.R and workarounds.R

- Really dont do any language generation stuff
- Always flush R output if running in debug

more renvstuff

commit message:
Don't refresh datasetpackage when setting new computed column type

Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-issues/issues/3913

When closing the workspace, the analyses are removed, and then the columns generated by the analyses (but not computed) are set to be just not computed column ( not linked to an analysis). This operation triggers the DataSetPackage to be refreshed, and sometimes this refresh crashes in the middle of Qt calls. But I don't see the need to refresh the DataSetPackage at all, so I just removed it, and since that the crashes does not occur anymore.

I have also replaced the disconect() calls to blockSignals(true) in the QML controls: the disconnect call was there to prevent some signals to be triggered though the JASP control being deleted. This disconnect is not recommended by Qt, and results in a warning that can cause a mutex deadlock in debug mode. So I just replace the disconnect by blockSignals

author: bruno boutin <b.boutin@uva.nl>
commit message:
Setting an interface font makes data disappears

. The main problem was that when the interface font is changed, it
should call (like for uiScale change) the viewPort change slot of the
DataSetView
. The DropDown settings in PrefsUI.qml were confusing: the value was
set to be the preferencesModel.interfaceFont, but onValueChanged signal
sets the preferencesModel.interfaceFont to value.
. The value should not be directly set in a DropDown, only the
currentIndex. If no currentIndex is known, then a new property is made
‘startValue’ that sets internally the right currentIndex.
. Moreover, when an item is being initialised, the properties are
changed from empty to the specified value. So onValueChanged is called
twice (empty and specified value), without real interaction with the
user. These calls should be avoided, so the property ‘initialized’ has
been added, and is set to true only when the control is fully
initialised, and can be used to avoid these extra onValueChanged calls.
. Remove obsolete isDirectModel property in ComboBox

* Generating markdown help from QML and R

Info now present on all jaspObjects and all jaspControls.
Implements https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/740
But the formatting can still use some work.

All filled info will be collected when the help is opened and will be updated whenever anything changes (aka translation).
For each qml element that has info but not a manually set "toolTip" the info will also be shown as a tooltip directly to give people easy access to the docs.
The info set in R is transmitted through the "meta" field and is coupled with the title of each object and displayed beneath the qml help.
This info could also be shown in between the results but I don't think that needs to be done right now.

commit message:
Condition on source using components

If a source use a component like a dropdown for example:
    'source: myVariables.drop' // if drop is the dropdown name.
And is this source use some condition using another component:
    'source: [{name: "myVariables.drop", condition: "check" }] // if check the name of checkbox component of the source.
Then the condition should be applied for the values of the source model.

To understand better what happens, see in the jaspTestModule, the "Test Sources with special attributes" analysis, "Source with controls" section

examples for plot builder (#5975)

* examples for plot builder

**Scatter plot**

This data set, "Big Five Personality Traits", provides scores of 500 participants on a Big Five personality questionnaire.

The example shows how to use the Plot builder module to create a scatter plot with *p* value.

**Repeates measures plot**

This data set, "Weight Gain", provides weights of 16 participants before and after an eight-week period of excessive calorie intake.

The example shows how to use the Plot builder module to create repeated measurements plots.

**Boxplot**

The data set contains 150 observations of three iris flower types: Setosa, Versicolor, and Virginica. Four features were measured from each flower in the data: the length and the width of the sepals and petals, in centimeters.

The example shows how to use the Plot builder module to create boxplots with p values.

**Plot layout**

This example demonstrates how to create a clear and well-structured plot layout using the Plot Builder, based on penguin data collected by scientists between 2007 and 2009 from three islands in the Palmer Archipelago in Antarctica.

commit message:
Generating markdown help from QML and R (#4076)

* Generating markdown help from QML and R

Info now present on all jaspObjects and all jaspControls.
Implements https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/740
But the formatting can still use some work.

All filled info will be collected when the help is opened and will be updated whenever anything changes (aka translation).
For each qml element that has info but not a manually set "toolTip" the info will also be shown as a tooltip directly to give people easy access to the docs.
The info set in R is transmitted through the "meta" field and is coupled with the title of each object and displayed beneath the qml help.
This info could also be shown in between the results but I don't think that needs to be done right now.

Also set some info on Summary Statistics Bayesian Binomial Test to get a feel for how it will look, so to see an example of this: turn on developers mode and open that analysis.

author: bruno boutin <b.boutin@uva.nl>
commit message:
Interaction in Factors Form should be kept (#6009)

* Interaction in Factors Form should be kept

In Linear Regression, if you add an interaction between 2 variables in one model, If you duplicate this analysis (or save in a JASP file, and reload this JASP file), then this interaction disappears.

A FactorsForm is a control that has itself an Available VariablesList and 1 or more Assigned VariablesLists. But only the FactorsForm has an option value (is bound), the others Assigned VariablesList do not have their proper option value: their values contribute to the value of the FactorsForm option. In the code, each control that is bound to an option value has a BoundControl object (some controls like Available VariablesList do not have a BoundControl as their value is not set in an option).

The error was that the Assigned VariablesList inside a FactorsForm had still a BoundControl object, and this lead to some confusion in the code.

What happened in Linear Regression is a bit tricky: the "model 1" has the assignAvailableVariablesToList property set to true, which means that when new variables are set in the Available VariablesList, these variables should be automatically set in the "model 1" VariablesList. But when this analysis is initiailized (either by duplicating the analysis, or by loading a JASP file containing a Linear Regression analysis), all controls are initialized when they are created: the "model 1' control is initialized with a null value (as it does not have its own value). In this particular case (assignAvailableVariablesToList is true and no value is given), as there might be default values in the Available VariablesList, which must be set in the Assigned VariablesList (this is for example the case in the ModelTerms of the Repeated Measures ANOVA), this default values are also set in the Assigned VariablesList (line 77 of VariablesListBase.cpp)
This is solved by just testing whether the control has a bound value
Also the BoundControl objects should not be created when the control has no bound value.

* Add better comment

The datafile timestamp was not stored in the JASP file, so when loading a JASP file, the data were always compared with the datafile. As the labels are not correctly compared, it thinks that the file has changed (cf https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/2614).

commit message:
Make JASP use renv stuff
- Part of https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/1237
- Break https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/1227 again
- Fix module request tryCatch thing
- Use checksums magic for avoiding reinstalling jasp* pkgs
- Really dont clean cache on linux
- Current R version should be a string not a double
- Updated buildingguide for windows about rtools40

Some MacOS stuff:
makedmg.sh changes for renv
- it should copy renv-cache
- It should replace all absolute symlinks in the build-folder/Modules by relative links to renv-cache
- it should remove BH https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/1285
- handling the symlinks is done in the new symlinkTools.R
-- it can collect all absolute symlinks in a data.frame (tested only on mac for now)
-- it can also use this data.frame to replace them all by their relative variants. (will probably break if the symlinks do not point to renv-cache btw)
-- call it from make-dmg.sh before copying

Some Windows stuff:
- windows symlinkTools.R script can now store junctions relatively in junctions.rds and another function can restore the entire Modules folder from that
- JASP and JASPEngine should be capable of running symlinkTools.R to collect junctions
- Paths should be under 260 chars otherwise WIX/light chokes, so follow path with ../.. to shave some chars off
- Copying *all* contents of jasp* pkgs is important
- Takeaway is that the installer now restores the modules-junctions. Zip should do this as well, but then on startup

- JAGS is now broken on Mac, see https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/1345
- Language files stuff has been removed because we dont need it anymore

Stuff since opening PR:
- more logging on module request
- Copy both symlinkTools.R and workarounds.R

- Something about the order in PATH
- Really dont do any language generation stuff
- Always flush R output if running in debug

more renvstuff
- Have buildoutput visible in the right places
- Copy include from R to installdir, then we can build stuff like backports...
- Copy Tcl from R to installdir, I guess it will make R less crashy when it tries to open windows/plots?

- Show ribbon icon if installed, not if loaded
- Always flush R output to see where it crashes
- maybe try *catching* errors instead of crashing JASP

Unknown value for a Radio Button leads to a crash

Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-test-release/issues/2026
This fixes the crash. The upgrade will be done in another PR.

The problem is that to ask whether a key exists in a map, you should call the 'contains' method, and not checking whether the map has a value with this key: this adds a new key in the map with an empty value. Thsi was done with the _buttons map, and the code expects always to have a not-null value in this map.

Remove ugly code

The Initialization of the available variablesList was quite ugly: a long comment in the bindTo method of the AnalysisForm object tried to explain how this initialization was done, but with this PR, I try to do it in the 'right way'.
The available VariablesLists have no bound value (they don't give values for the analysis), but they must be initialized. For this, as the setInitialized is called even for these controls, just override this method in VaraibelListBase, so that:
. when it has an avalable list model, then it should get its values from its sources.

Beter handling of Selection. mouse click and right-click behaviour on the Data view (#5134)

* Beter handling of Selection. mouse click and right-click behaviour on the Data view

In the DataView, different issues have been solved:
. Select a cell, right click on another cell: the selected cell should be unselected, and the pop-up menu should appear
. Select some cells, right-click on one of these cells: the selected cells should stay selected, and the pop-uo menu shoulp appear. A right-click on an unselected cell should unselect the selected cells, select the new cell, and the pop-up menu should appear. A simple click (on a selected cell or not) unselect the other cells, and select the current cell, and this cell gets the focus.
. Click on a row header: the whole row should be selected. Click on one cell (selected or not), the row is unselected, only the current cell is selected and has the focus. Right click on a selected cell: the row stays selected, and a pop-up menu appears on the clicked cell. Right -click on a unselected cell, the row is unselected and a pop-up menu appears on the clicked cell.
. Click on a row header and shift-click on another row header: all the rows between the 2 rows shoudl be selected. Same behaviour as with only one row selected.. If delete row is selected from the pop-up menu or from the ribbon menu: all the selected rows should be removed.
. Same behaviour with column header

author: bruno boutin <b.boutin@uva.nl>
commit message:
rSource provokes running engine endlessly

This bug is accidentally revealed by the rSource, but it is a more general bug: when a value of a control is changed, it emits a signal so that the analysis must be rerun. This signal is sometimes blocked when some block code may change many values (initializing of analysis for example), and it is unblocked at the end of the block. When unblocked the signal was always emitted even if the signal was not called during the block code. But this signal must be emitted only if the signal was called during the block code.

commit message:
Better handling of Dynamic modules and (re)loading
- Removed some stuff from Analysis/Analyses for oldstyle modules, as we don't have them anymore
- Made sure reloading Development Module does not crash anymore
-- fixes: https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/1175
-- This was solved by remembering the _slaveFinishedConnection = connect(_slaveProcess, QOverload<int, QProcess::ExitStatus>::of(&QProcess::finished),	this, &EngineRepresentation::processFinished);
-- And removing it when an engine stopped, a race condition occured whereby the new engine started so fast it got the "closed" signal from the previous one and interpreted it as a crash. While in fact it worked fine.
- Added a loading indicator in the ribbonbar for modules while they are loading
- Added an error indicator, but Im not sure in which situation a module would have an error *and remain installed/loaded*. So not actually sure if it makes sense or not. I guess it would be useful in case an icon is missing. But a then a question mark would make more sense.
- Added a few more logging statements to engine startup
- Removed the "not running analyses on engine 0" define in the constructor of EngineRepresentation...

commit message:
Makes multibridge work on macos Arm!

To use this commit and actually have bug https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-test-release/issues/2325 fixed
you need to remove `gmp` and `mpfr` as installed by `brew`.

Then download a snapshot of `gmp`: https://gmplib.org/download/snapshot/gmp-next/gmp-6.2.99-20221117121717.tar.zst
Build with:
./configure --enable-static --disable-shared --with-pic --enable-cxx
make -j
make check #These NEED to pass
sudo make install

Then build `mpfr` and use:
./configure --enable-static --disable-shared --with-pic --with-gmp=/usr/local
make -j
sudo make install

Then to make sure Qt creator can actually find pkg-config (sigh) you need to start it from a terminal

Make sure to `git submodule update --init` too

Then use a fresh buildfolder or remove at least `_cache`, `_deps`, `_scripts`, `Modules`, and `Frameworks`
Run cmake and verify `multibridge` is installed at the end, it will probably give some loading namespace errors during help generation but that can be ignored

author: František Bartoš <38475991+FBartos@users.noreply.github.com>
commit message:
fix: suppress UI Automation events during form creation to prevent slowdown (#6173)

* fix: suppress UI Automation events during form creation to prevent slowdown

On Windows 11 machines with Power Automate Desktop (or other UI Automation
clients) running in the background, creating analysis forms became
progressively slower — the 3rd duplicate took ~19 seconds instead of <1s.

Root cause: Power Automate Desktop runs a background UIA server
(PAD.AutomationServer.exe) that intercepts every text-change accessibility
event. Each setText() on a QML TextField triggered a cross-process UIA
notification through the Windows kernel, adding ~65ms overhead per call.
With 35+ text fields per form and the cost scaling with total QML objects
in the scene, form creation ground to a halt.

Fix: install a no-op QAccessible update handler for the duration of
Analysis::createForm(), suppressing all accessibility notifications
during bulk QML object construction. The previous handler is restored
immediately after, so accessibility works normally during user interaction.

This uses Qt's public QAccessible::installUpdateHandler API and requires
no platform-specific code, no form lifecycle changes, and no reduction
in functionality.


* refactor: use qScopeGuard for accessibility handler restoration

Ensures the previous QAccessible update handler is always restored,
even if future code changes introduce early returns or new error paths
in Analysis::createForm().

* fix: suppress UIA events during row control creation

Same Power Automate Desktop / UI Automation issue as form creation:
adding rows to QML component lists (e.g., in the distribution module)
triggers bulk control creation with text property writes, each incurring
~65ms UIA overhead. Apply the same QAccessible suppression pattern.

author: boutinb <b.boutin@uva.nl>
commit message:
FactorsForm does not need a source

Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-test-release/issues/2214
The FactorsForm is a form with an AvailableVariablesList and repreater with FactorList (a kind of AssignedVariablesList). The FatorsForm has a model: the ListModelFactorsForm. This model does not need a source.
Per default, a model needs a source, and if not set, it gets the DataSet source. When the DataSet is reset (by adding or removing a Computed column), the ListModelFactorsForm is reset, destroying and rebuilding the FactorLists. As the AvailableVariableList maintains a list of its AssignedVariablesList, this leads to a crash.
Just set the _needsSource to false

commit message:
Generating markdown help from QML and R (#4076)

* Generating markdown help from QML and R

Info now present on all jaspObjects and all jaspControls.
Implements https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/740
But the formatting can still use some work.

All filled info will be collected when the help is opened and will be updated whenever anything changes (aka translation).
For each qml element that has info but not a manually set "toolTip" the info will also be shown as a tooltip directly to give people easy access to the docs.
The info set in R is transmitted through the "meta" field and is coupled with the title of each object and displayed beneath the qml help.
This info could also be shown in between the results but I don't think that needs to be done right now.

Also set some info on Summary Statistics Bayesian Binomial Test to get a feel for how it will look, so to see an example of this: turn on developers mode and open that analysis.

* Forgot qsTr()

* Add qsTr to BayesFactorType.qml

* Moved the controlType to friendly name to the virtual friendlyName function on JASPControlWrapper

commit message:
If the engine takes too long to pause just kill it instead of crashing the entire GUI
- implements https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/875
- Small tweak to also kill the engine if it doesnt respond to a stopRequest
- Implemented a "abort analysis if no response" on option changes
- Make sure engines pause gracefully and do not kill the desktop for each little unexpected reply.
-- Some of them are unexpected but not that bad, so it is nice to be able to differentiate those errors from others (new exception added)
- Added an exception to enumutilities to be able to catch the "missing enum val problem" specifically (aka entered a string that isnt an enumval)
- Resume engine now also sends the settings, this avoids another send->reply cycle afterwards
- Split the filter pause-resume from running the filter so that a process loop can be made in between and let the desktop possibly respond to something
- Engine now also reads in columnnames on startup, because maybe it just started after being killed (or just plain crashing ofc)
- We might be on a killing spree but it would be nice if the desktop also responds well to an engine that *does* respond properly to option changes.
-- For this Ive added a KeepStatus Analysis::Status that tells the Analysis it should, well duh, keep it's current status instead of changing it to something new.
- Taken some code for ~MainWindow from stablish branch that destroys all the loaded qml in reverse order
-- this should avoid a bunch of qml warnings/errors were the qml was dependent on other objects that are already deleted by MainWindow
- If the analysis is aborted by killing on an optionchange we refresh it to make sure we do not get any half-written files, I think this is unlikely but not impossible so it is good to aboid it entirely.
- Also added a cleanUpAfterClose() on EngineRepresentation because otherwise some info might be stuck there after closing a workspace.

that the data is changed, but the changes in the form should be handled
only by the datasetChanged signal in ColumnModel. All other signal
before should be ignored.
Als the Repeated Measures control did not handle well when some columns
are missing.
The RepeatedMeasuresFactorsList has been a bit reshaped to a
FactorLevelList so that it becomes a bit more generic.

- And removed some legacy JS code, pretty sure this doesn't affect anything but would appreciate if Tim glances at it suavely.

* Fixes progressbar stuff

* - Make sure Bayesian ANOVA doesnt break all modules when running and changing language
- Load all modules at the same time for faster startup and less loading symbols. Might fix https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/1224 as well

commit message:
Datafile timestamp not stored in JASP file

Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/2611

The datafile timestamp was not stored in the JASP file, so when loading a JASP file, the data were always compared with the datafile. As the labels are not correctly compared, it thinks that the file has changed (cf https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/2614).

Moreover there was a bug in the JASP files in 0.18.3 (and earlier): when reading the sqlite database, the description and the datafile path were exchanged.

* Makes multibridge work on macos Arm!

To use this commit and actually have bug https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-test-release/issues/2325 fixed
you need to remove `gmp` and `mpfr` as installed by `brew`.

Then download a snapshot of `gmp`: https://gmplib.org/download/snapshot/gmp-next/gmp-6.2.99-20221117121717.tar.zst
Build with:
./configure --enable-static --disable-shared --with-pic --enable-cxx
make -j
make check #These NEED to pass
sudo make install

Then build `mpfr` and use:
./configure --enable-static --disable-shared --with-pic --with-gmp=/usr/local
make -j
sudo make install

Then to make sure Qt creator can actually find pkg-config (sigh) you need to start it from a terminal

Make sure to `git submodule update --init` too

Then use a fresh buildfolder or remove at least `_cache`, `_deps`, `_scripts`, `Modules`, and `Frameworks`
Run cmake and verify `multibridge` is installed at the end, it will probably give some loading namespace errors during help generation but that can be ignored

* Only preinstall deps and multibridge on macos ARM

* 0.17.3 Mac ARM

commit message:
Update regressionlinear.R

Hi! There is problem with the R squared change option in Linear Regression. 
The overall problem is that the R squared change option does not make really sense as long as one cannot add blocks of parameters (hierarchical regression). I am really waiting for this feature because it is so basic.
Thus, for the time being the R squared change option just repeats R squared of the model (r.squared.old <- r.squared, line 673), and the F.change statistic should repeat the model F-Test. It doesn't, however, in case of more than one predictor, because the df1 always  equals 1. This is because abs(length(lm.model[[ m ]]$variables) - length(lm.model[[ m-1 ]]$variables)) always equals 1. As soon as you have the "real" F-change function you need: df1 <- abs(length(lm.model[[ m ]]$variables) - length(lm.model[[ m-(NUMBER OF ADDED PARAMETERS)  ]]$variables)).
But as long as you can't report a real F-Change-Statistic, you need to set df1 = m (number of predictors). Otherwise you get the correct model F-value * m in the F-Change outcome.
Thanks!
Boris

commit message:
Prophet analysis: adding seasonality may crash

In Prophet, if you change the name of a seasonality, and directly add a new one, it crashes.
This is caused by asking for a value in a QMap by directly calling the [] operator: if no value is found, it adds an empty entry. The QMap value method prevents this problem.

commit message:
Makes multibridge work on macos Arm!

To use this commit and actually have bug https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-test-release/issues/2325 fixed
you need to remove `gmp` and `mpfr` as installed by `brew`.

Then download a snapshot of `gmp`: https://gmplib.org/download/snapshot/gmp-next/gmp-6.2.99-20221117121717.tar.zst
Build with:
./configure --enable-static --disable-shared --with-pic --enable-cxx
make -j
make check #These NEED to pass
sudo make install

Then build `mpfr` and use:
./configure --enable-static --disable-shared --with-pic --with-gmp=/usr/local
make -j
sudo make install

Then to make sure Qt creator can actually find pkg-config (sigh) you need to start it from a terminal

Make sure to `git submodule update --init` too

Then use a fresh buildfolder or remove at least `_cache`, `_deps`, `_scripts`, `Modules`, and `Frameworks`
Run cmake and verify `multibridge` is installed at the end, it will probably give some loading namespace errors during help generation but that can be ignored

commit message:
Encoding column names changed

- Change encoding of columnNames to something less complicated.
- Every column is now simply encoded to JaspColumn_.#._Encoded and no nonsense with base64 and all that.
- R uses the same code as C++. (issue: https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/543)
- This Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/353 (en/decoding cyrillic doesn't work)
-.v and .unv have been turned off though because of moving encoding/decoding out of R Issue https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/95
- new encoding and decoding functions have been added under columnEncoding.R and should also work in jaspTools (by not encoding and decoding then)
- Plots however now are messed up... Because they do not decode anything the changed names are shown, this should be fixed in JaspGraphs and manually in basePlots?
- Should also fix issue with ordering of dataset columns (https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-issues/issues/41)
- A sort of meta entry has been added to the options to tell the engine what it should expect to be columnNames

commit message:
Beter handling of Selection. mouse click and right-click behaviour on the Data view (#5134)

* Beter handling of Selection. mouse click and right-click behaviour on the Data view

In the DataView, different issues have been solved:
. Select a cell, right click on another cell: the selected cell should be unselected, and the pop-up menu should appear
. Select some cells, right-click on one of these cells: the selected cells should stay selected, and the pop-uo menu shoulp appear. A right-click on an unselected cell should unselect the selected cells, select the new cell, and the pop-up menu should appear. A simple click (on a selected cell or not) unselect the other cells, and select the current cell, and this cell gets the focus.
. Click on a row header: the whole row should be selected. Click on one cell (selected or not), the row is unselected, only the current cell is selected and has the focus. Right click on a selected cell: the row stays selected, and a pop-up menu appears on the clicked cell. Right -click on a unselected cell, the row is unselected and a pop-up menu appears on the clicked cell.
. Click on a row header and shift-click on another row header: all the rows between the 2 rows shoudl be selected. Same behaviour as with only one row selected.. If delete row is selected from the pop-up menu or from the ribbon menu: all the selected rows should be removed.
. Same behaviour with column header

* Rens issues

If you specify columnName on the qml object it will show a single row of doubles with a column for each label/level that specified column has.

commit message:
0.17.3 mac arm (#5160)

* Added jaspTimeSeries Module

* Update jaspAudit and alter TimeSeries version

* Alter to 0.17.3

* specify branch for TimeSeries

* oops

* Makes multibridge work on macos Arm!

To use this commit and actually have bug https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-test-release/issues/2325 fixed
you need to remove `gmp` and `mpfr` as installed by `brew`.

Then download a snapshot of `gmp`: https://gmplib.org/download/snapshot/gmp-next/gmp-6.2.99-20221117121717.tar.zst
Build with:
./configure --enable-static --disable-shared --with-pic --enable-cxx
make -j
make check #These NEED to pass
sudo make install

Then build `mpfr` and use:
./configure --enable-static --disable-shared --with-pic --with-gmp=/usr/local
make -j
sudo make install

Then to make sure Qt creator can actually find pkg-config (sigh) you need to start it from a terminal

Make sure to `git submodule update --init` too

Then use a fresh buildfolder or remove at least `_cache`, `_deps`, `_scripts`, `Modules`, and `Frameworks`
Run cmake and verify `multibridge` is installed at the end, it will probably give some loading namespace errors during help generation but that can be ignored

* Only preinstall deps and multibridge on macos ARM

* 0.17.3 Mac ARM

commit message:
Handling csv encoding on windows
- Add the BOM back to the debug.csv so that we can actually see the unicode. BOM isnt necessary on mac or linux (or really at all for utf-8) but Windows makes things complicated
- Changed CSV import to assume that not having a BOM while loading a csv on windows means you are loading the native variant. This could go wrong if you copy a csv made on korean locale to a german computer and load it into JASP there.
- Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-issues/issues/975 and possibly https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-issues/issues/232
- Adds a setting for windows users to disable the "no bom means native" and disabling it just restores the way it used to work.

commit message:
Makes multibridge work on macos Arm!

To use this commit and actually have bug https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-test-release/issues/2325 fixed
you need to remove `gmp` and `mpfr` as installed by `brew`.

Then download a snapshot of `gmp`: https://gmplib.org/download/snapshot/gmp-next/gmp-6.2.99-20221117121717.tar.zst
Build with:
./configure --enable-static --disable-shared --with-pic --enable-cxx
make -j
make check #These NEED to pass
sudo make install

Then build `mpfr` and use:
./configure --enable-static --disable-shared --with-pic --with-gmp=/usr/local
make -j
sudo make install

Then to make sure Qt creator can actually find pkg-config (sigh) you need to start it from a terminal

Make sure to `git submodule update --init` too

Then use a fresh buildfolder or remove at least `_cache`, `_deps`, `_scripts`, `Modules`, and `Frameworks`
Run cmake and verify `multibridge` is installed at the end, it will probably give some loading namespace errors during help generation but that can be ignored

commit message:
Don't refresh datasetpackage when setting new computed column type

Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-issues/issues/3913

When closing the workspace, the analyses are removed, and then the columns generated by the analyses (but not computed) are set to be just not computed column ( not linked to an analysis). This operation triggers the DataSetPackage to be refreshed, and sometimes this refresh crashes in the middle of Qt calls. But I don't see the need to refresh the DataSetPackage at all, so I just removed it, and since that the crashes does not occur anymore.

I have also replaced the disconect() calls to blockSignals(true) in the QML controls: the disconnect call was there to prevent some signals to be triggered though the JASP control being deleted. This disconnect is not recommended by Qt, and results in a warning that can cause a mutex deadlock in debug mode. So I just replace the disconnect by blockSignals

commit message:
Updated .checkMultinomialCounts() & changed Alt. hypotheses to Test Values (#3247)

* updated .checkMultinomialCounts() and relabeled Alt. hypotheses to Test Values

- only observed counts must be integer values; expected counts can be either integers or proportions

- added a check that observed and expected counts vector cannot get too big. otherwise the computation takes up too much memory and the analysis crashes

* Fixing Big Counts Issue

1) Rewrote analysis. If binom.test() breaks (due to large counts) when computing CIs then, analysis captures error message and returns NaN in the descriptives table and it won't show credible intervals. It also adds a Note to the descriptives table.

2) The frequentist multinomial test function now uses .multComputeCI function, too.

3) Fixed issues with plot margins within base_brakes_y function

* fix yAxis margin

* Transform table with observed counts into numeric vector

column in tableFrame requires vector with observed counts, however, chisqResults[[1]][["observed"]] returns a table. Therefore, I added the wrapper as.numeric() around it to receive the oberved frequencies

commit message:
The source of a Dropdown should be fetched before its value is set when reading a JASP file

Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-test-release/issues/1780
This solves 2 problems:
. a dropdown with a source is not set properly when a JASP file is read: if the dropdown was set with a value coming from the source, when reading the JASP file, if the values of the source are not yet read, setting the dropdown generates an error. This is the case in the ANOVA analysis: the 'Reference model for weight ratios' dropdown in the Order Restriction, has for source the titles of the tabs of the Order Restriction models. If the dropdown is set with one of these values, reading a JASP file with this setting will lead to an error.
. if an error is set to a control, removing this error lets the analysis is an error state, and the analysis cannot run anymore.

In AnalysisForm, the terms of an available model (which is the case for a dropdown) should be fetched before the value of the dropdown is set.
Also remove the _getControlErrorMessageOfControl method which is not used anymore.
In ControlErrorMessage, when the message is closed, its association with its control should be removed: in this way the AnalysisForm::hasError becomes false.

author: bruno boutin <b.boutin@uva.nl>
commit message:
Upgrade FactorsForm control with nested VariablesList feature (#5450)

Add properties to the `FactorsForm` control so that it can be used with nested `VariablesList`: the values of the n'th `VariablesList` should be inside the (n+1)th `VariablesList` as undraggable items.

Change the `_copyTermsWhenDropped` flag in `ListModelDraggable` to `_removeTermsWhenMoved`: `_copyTermsWhenDropped` was not used to determine the behaviour of its own `VariablesList`, but the one from whom the terms is taken from. That was quite difficult to understand and lead also to issue for the `FactorForm`.
`_removeTermsWhenMoved` indicates that the `VariablesList` of this model should remove the/its variables when they are moved to another `VariablesList`. 

The source, typically an `AvailableVariablesList`, of an assigned `VariablesList` with interactions or a `VariablesList` with paired variables (eg Paired Samples T-Test) should not lose their variables when they are moved to these assigned variableslists.

A new Test `FactorsForm` analysis has been added in the Test Module

commit message:
When Tab name changes, the bound value should be first updated

Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-test-release/issues/1822

When the name of a tab is changed, the nameChangedHandler of the ComponentsListBase is called, which calls the changeTerm method of its model. But as the name of a tab is also the key value of the bound value, this value must be first changed in the bound value so that the other control values of the tab can be found.

author: František Bartoš <f.bartos96@gmail.com>
commit message:
fix: destroy inactive analysis forms to prevent QML scene graph bloat (#3136)

On Windows, opening multiple analyses caused JASP to slow to a crawl.
The 3rd analysis took ~18 seconds to open. Root cause: QML forms were
never destroyed when collapsed — only hidden via visible:false. All QML
objects accumulated in the scene graph, making every setProperty() call
on TextInputBase controls progressively slower due to Qt's binding
evaluation scaling with total object count.

Fix: destroy forms when their analysis is deselected, recreate on
re-selection. Bound values are preserved in Analysis::_boundValues.
Qt.callLater ensures the old form is destroyed before the new one is
created, keeping the scene graph small.

Also adds [PERF] timing instrumentation across the form creation
pipeline for ongoing performance monitoring.

    (1) credible intervals Bayesian correlation matrix and Bayesian correlation pairs, (2) p-values for sumstat Kendall's tau

    R changes:
    - give sensible p-values and BF for Kendall’s tau when n <=2
    - Only partially cleaned up correlation.R
    - added isTRUE in code for robustness reason
    - Removed additional layer in the bfObject when it comes to ci. Check
    for ci goes via bfObject$ciValue, say, 0.95, and the intervals are in
    bfObject$ci$twoSided, bfObject$ci$plusSided, bfObject$ci$minSided.
    - Example: bfObject$ciValue <- 0.95 and bfObject$ci$twoSided <- c(-0.3,
    -0.2, 0.1). Tells me that the 95% CI is from -0.3 to 0.1. The point
    -0.2 is the median.

    Style:
    - reordered the input in kendall tau functions, first data, then
    parameters then hyperparameters: Data: n, tauObs. Parameters: tauPop,
    Hyperparameters: kappa, var=1
    - .bfKendallTau is a wrapper around .bfCorrieKernelKendallTau.
    Basically, it switches between various methods and various variances
    - Removed double function definitions in .correlationbayesianpairs.R

commit message:
Handling csv encoding on windows
- Add the BOM back to the debug.csv so that we can actually see the unicode. BOM isnt necessary on mac or linux (or really at all for utf-8) but Windows makes things complicated
- Changed CSV import to assume that not having a BOM while loading a csv on windows means you are loading the native variant. This could go wrong if you copy a csv made on korean locale to a german computer and load it into JASP there.
- Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-issues/issues/975 and possibly https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-issues/issues/232
- Adds a setting for windows users to disable the "no bom means native" and disabling it just restores the way it used to work.

Check valid computed column from old JASP file

Apparently in the JASP file of the issue, a computed column was made that made the engine crash. This computed column is still written in the metadata.json, but it is ignored in 0.17.3. When upgrading to 0.18.1, this computed column is added and makes the engine crash. So just ignore this computed column when upgrading.

Some problems in Learn Bayes analyses

Fixes jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp#1036

. When a TextField has a binding for its value (e.g TextField { value:
“TEST ” + myCheckBox.checked ? “YES” : “NO” } ), then if you change the
value manually, and then change the value of the binding (in the
example, you click the myCheckBox), then the value of the TextField is
changed according to the binding.
The startValue property has been added in order to avoid this
behaviour: the startValue is used only when the TextField is created,
and the binding will not affect anymore the value of the TextField.

. When a ComponentsList (or a VariablesList) uses a rowComponent having
the same name as the optionKey, no error was thrown (this generates the
problem in issue jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp#1036). An error is now

commit message:
Grand update

JASP now supports a variable amount of engines
- This will also allow users to set a max amount of engines and just be more intelligent about it in general https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/568
- It starts with a single engine.
- When a module request, analysis or rscript cannot find an idle engine and there are less workers than allowed engines a new engine is started every so many secs (10 now, in a define)
- When an engine has been idle for 10m it shuts down.

Besides I removed a whole bunch of stuff that we don't need anymore.
- Init Initing etc is not used so removed
- description.json is not used so removed
- usesJaspResults in qml and other places has been removed (But added workaround in Form for Koen)

Several other fixes
- Analyses loaded from a jaspfile now start running if they werent Complete or FatalError on saving.
- Memory is now cleaned up a bit after an analysis through some functions I added to jaspBase
- Make sure a development module of a jaspModule also replaces the loaded module

commit message:
Beter handling of Selection. mouse click and right-click behaviour on the Data view (#5134)

* Beter handling of Selection. mouse click and right-click behaviour on the Data view

In the DataView, different issues have been solved:
. Select a cell, right click on another cell: the selected cell should be unselected, and the pop-up menu should appear
. Select some cells, right-click on one of these cells: the selected cells should stay selected, and the pop-uo menu shoulp appear. A right-click on an unselected cell should unselect the selected cells, select the new cell, and the pop-up menu should appear. A simple click (on a selected cell or not) unselect the other cells, and select the current cell, and this cell gets the focus.
. Click on a row header: the whole row should be selected. Click on one cell (selected or not), the row is unselected, only the current cell is selected and has the focus. Right click on a selected cell: the row stays selected, and a pop-up menu appears on the clicked cell. Right -click on a unselected cell, the row is unselected and a pop-up menu appears on the clicked cell.
. Click on a row header and shift-click on another row header: all the rows between the 2 rows shoudl be selected. Same behaviour as with only one row selected.. If delete row is selected from the pop-up menu or from the ribbon menu: all the selected rows should be removed.

commit message:
Build JASP with Qt Static libs

Only Common, CommonData, QMLComponnents, R-INterface and SyntaxBridge needs to be compiled with static Qt libraries
For this detect this by loading the Qt Core library and set USE_QT_STATIC_QT_LIBS  to ON if the QtCore lib is static.
The SyntaxBridge is built as a shared library so that it can be used directly by the jaspSyntax R package: for this it uses the qt_import_qml_plugins CMAKE function so that Qt loads automatically the needed (static) plugins in the SyntaxBridge library (with the use of a Dummy.sql that uses all the needed import statement).
Also SyntaxBridge needs to load the Qt Minimal plugin platform so that the jaspSyntax can start a Qt application to load the QML form.

Saving the modified file however also didnt work because the check for the importer somehow blew out the constructor of ArchiveReader thereby avoiding the close() in the destructor
we just never noticed because none of us work on windows a lot I think

    (1) credible intervals Bayesian correlation matrix and Bayesian correlation pairs, (2) p-values for sumstat Kendall's tau

    R changes:
    - give sensible p-values and BF for Kendall’s tau when n <=2
    - Only partially cleaned up correlation.R

    - Removed additional layer in the bfObject when it comes to ci. Check

    -0.2 is the median.

    - reordered the input in kendall tau functions, first data, then
    parameters then hyperparameters: Data: n, tauObs. Parameters: tauPop,

    Basically, it switches between various methods and various variances
    - Removed double function definitions in .correlationbayesianpairs.R

author: bruno boutin <b.boutin@uva.nl>
commit message:
Handle better the constraints inside the Plot Editor

The constraints of the 'from' and 'to' values in the ticks settings are reinforced so that the 'from' value is always smaller than the 'to' value (with exception when the steps is negative: this is a strange default behaviour of the Raincloud plots).
Also when setting manually the ticks, it is not anymore possible to set the value of position smaller than its left value and bigger than its right value.

When the ticks are changed (either by specifying the sequence or setting them manually), the manual Lower & Upper limits (in Advanced) are changed also automatically as long as these limits are not previously changed manually (in fact as long as the upper & lower limits correspond to the 'from' and 'to' values).
The limit type (based on data, ticks or set manually) is not changed anymore.
This solves https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-test-release/issues/1502
and part of https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-test-release/issues/1385

Solve crash when opening help for Classical Meta-Analysis

A TextArea is a JASPListControl because it may has a model (TextTypeSource, TextTypeJAGSmodel, TextTypeLavaan, TextTypeMetaSem, TextTypeCSem use a model), but other types like the TextTypeDefault one, does not have a model.
So JASPListControl should always check that this model exists, before using it.

commit message:
Some fixes to get SEM to load properly and general improvements (#4544)

* Some fixes to get SEM to load properly and general improvements
- the lavaan textarea does not necessarily need syntax$model and syntax$columns as long as it has modelOriginal. Because the others are derived from it.
- to make that work however rscripts should not be silently dropped when signals from the form are blocked. Instead they are now put in a queue and only sent after signals arent blocked anymore.
- this can however make stuff load repeatedly because we do not, until now, check if a boundvalue actually changed if a value is set. So now before and after is compared and a refresh signal is only sent when the options actually changed. This should save some unnecessary engine
activity
- fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/INTERNAL-jasp/issues/1399 (SEM backward compat)

* - Only run waiting scripts on wasUpgraded
- Only emit change if not wasUpgraded
- Remove superfluous emitchanged = blabla && emitChange

* Only run waiting rscripts after upgrade or on notifyUnblocked

When a new dataset is created, the engines are restarted. But as the dataMode is true, the resumeEmgines function does not resume the engine, and especially the _stopProcessing is not reset to false.
As _stopProcessing stays false, no engine is called to process the analysis.
But the resumeEngines is called either with
. processFilterScript
. file is closed (it calls cleanRestart that calls resumeEngines(
. when a new language is chosen.
In this 3 cases , there is no reason why the resumeEngines should be blocked in data mode.

commit message:
Beter handling of Selection. mouse click and right-click behaviour on the Data view (#5134)

* Beter handling of Selection. mouse click and right-click behaviour on the Data view

In the DataView, different issues have been solved:
. Select a cell, right click on another cell: the selected cell should be unselected, and the pop-up menu should appear
. Select some cells, right-click on one of these cells: the selected cells should stay selected, and the pop-uo menu shoulp appear. A right-click on an unselected cell should unselect the selected cells, select the new cell, and the pop-up menu should appear. A simple click (on a selected cell or not) unselect the other cells, and select the current cell, and this cell gets the focus.
. Click on a row header: the whole row should be selected. Click on one cell (selected or not), the row is unselected, only the current cell is selected and has the focus. Right click on a selected cell: the row stays selected, and a pop-up menu appears on the clicked cell. Right -click on a unselected cell, the row is unselected and a pop-up menu appears on the clicked cell.
. Click on a row header and shift-click on another row header: all the rows between the 2 rows shoudl be selected. Same behaviour as with only one row selected.. If delete row is selected from the pop-up menu or from the ribbon menu: all the selected rows should be removed.
. Same behaviour with column header

Beter handling of Selection. mouse click and right-click behaviour on the Data view (#5134)

* Beter handling of Selection. mouse click and right-click behaviour on the Data view

In the DataView, different issues have been solved:
. Select a cell, right click on another cell: the selected cell should be unselected, and the pop-up menu should appear
. Select some cells, right-click on one of these cells: the selected cells should stay selected, and the pop-uo menu shoulp appear. A right-click on an unselected cell should unselect the selected cells, select the new cell, and the pop-up menu should appear. A simple click (on a selected cell or not) unselect the other cells, and select the current cell, and this cell gets the focus.
. Click on a row header: the whole row should be selected. Click on one cell (selected or not), the row is unselected, only the current cell is selected and has the focus. Right click on a selected cell: the row stays selected, and a pop-up menu appears on the clicked cell. Right -click on a unselected cell, the row is unselected and a pop-up menu appears on the clicked cell.
. Click on a row header and shift-click on another row header: all the rows between the 2 rows shoudl be selected. Same behaviour as with only one row selected.. If delete row is selected from the pop-up menu or from the ribbon menu: all the selected rows should be removed.

commit message:
The value of a control initialized by a file should not change via binding (#4708)

* The value of a control initilaized by a file should not change via binding

Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-test-release/issues/1760

If a value of a control is set with a binding in QML (for example a DoubleField is set per default by the number of variables selected by the user), this value can be changed by the user self to another value. If this value is saved in a JASP file, when reading the file, JASP must prevent the binding to overwrite the value.
This mechanism exists already via the _resetBindingValue JASPControl function. But in a case of an upgrade, an option that did not exist in a previous version, may have a default value set via a binding. In this particular case, the value should not be reset.

* Change _initializedByFile by _initializedFromJaspFile

commit message:
[WIP] Qt6 - Bringing JASP up to speed (#4677)

* Added the boost:: namespace to all the filesystem. This resolves a conflict when we move to the C++17

* replaced the deprecated QSet::toList()

* Replaced the deprecated `QString::split(QRegEx ...)` with `QString::split(QRegularExpression, ...)`

* Resolved the casting error. I don't know why we need to do get it to QChar, but if we have to, we can do `QChar point = *locale().decimalPoint().toStdString().c_str();`

* This will cause some confusion for the compiler later when the mocing happens. It's a `bool` anyway!

* - Added the missing const operator

* These are not ideal, but C++17 will complain if the types do not match, because `std::max`, `std::min` are template functions. So, we need to consider this. There are more instance of them around which we need to deal with. They are not causing error because they are safer casts but still.

* Replaced the qSort with std::sort. qSort is deprecated, and std::sort is N * Log(N) as well.

* Replaced `qsrand` and `qrand` with `std::srand`, and `std::rand`. Those two are discontinued. If we care, we can do better in c++11/17 regarding the random number

* Using QIODeviceBase instead of `QIODevice` for getting the `OpenModeFlag`. They are not in the `QIODevice` anymore!

* Replaced `midRef` and `leftRef` with `QtString::mid` and `QtString::left`. They are the same and old ones are gone! Btw, they return QString anyway!

* The old one is obsolete

* I'm not so sure about this one, but I think that's you wanted to do. From 6.1, we can use `QLocal::codeToLanguage` to deal with this. We can perhaps replace the entire `isValidLocal` with it since it returns a proper error

* `QDateTime::toTime_t()` is obsolete.

* :exclamation: This is probably not exactly what we want, but getting it right was beyond the focus of this branch. I'm mainly trying to get the 6.2 to work at this point. I'm not even sure what this file does!

* This is an infinite loop. `QStringList.toVector()` spits out `QList<QString>`. Qt Creator picks it up, and shows a warning for it.

I really hope there were a line on top of these file describing their purpose. I have no idea what this file does, or what `fq`, `tq, `fqj` mean!

* Some more minor adaptation. Overall, c++17 is even more strict with types because of the templates and enum classes and Qt 6.2 follows along which is very nice in fact.

- The `UTF-8` is the default option
- The `GL_Lines` is now inside an enum class
- The `fromStdVector` is deprecated. They are relying on `initializer_list` overall which is very nice too. I used a new syntax there, but we will see if we like it or not
- and finally inserted some missing headers

* By the last commit, at least C++ doesn't nag anymore. So, here we are activating the c++17 flag, and moving to the QML side of things. I had to make a few changes to the QMake commands to get a proper c++17 build, but they can be removed or simplified as we move to CMake. I also activated some of the errors to make sure that at this stage I get most of the tricky stuff, of course we can disable them later.

* :warning: Disabled the shadow effects, by removing the `QtGraphicalEffects`. This has moved into the `Qt5Compat.GraphicalEffects` and I expect it to either be implemented somewhere else, or be deprecated soon. We can bring it back if we need to.

* :warning: Replaced the instances of QtQuick.Controls 1.4 with QtQuick.Controls 6.0 wherever was needed! I think Qt is changing their naming scheme, and they are giving their control an umbrella version number which is very nice, but that might cause some issues for us. I think this breaks the SplitView but I cannot immediately see why. I'm marking these commits that we can go back to them, and evaluate our choices

* :exclamation: These are breaking changes, and we need to find a workaround for them

- Styling has changed and this is not valid anymore. I think this might be breaking the AboutWindows but I'm not sure. I feel that's related to the WebEngineQuick. See next commit.
- Commented a bug regarding the shortcut, this should be done differently but I am leaving it for later. I have a list! :P
- I don't think Button has `checkable` and `checked`, maybe it has but Qt doesn't like it. It's not also our Button. I checked!

* :exclamation: Successful build, but broken app!

- Replacing the `QtWebEngine` with `QtWebEngineQuick`. This is explained [here](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qtwebengine-changes-qt6.html). One thing that is strange to me is the initialization of the WebEngine. I see Joris' comment, but then [here](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qtwebenginequick.html#initialize) it says that it should be initialized before the instantiation of the QApplication.
- I traced back a crash to the `DataSetPackage::index` where that point was causing some termination. I am not 100% sure what's happening there, but I'm not the fan of those pointers. I have tried to deal with it in different ways, but I didn't manage to get it to behave. I think there is something with the enum that breaks it, and leaving it uninitialized at least gives me the build.

but a step in the right direction nonetheless.

commit message:
Interaction in Factors Form should be kept

In Linear Regression, if you add an interaction between 2 variables in one model, If you duplicate this analysis (or save in a JASP file, and reload this JASP file), then this interaction disappears.

A FactorsForm is a control that has itself an Available VariablesList and 1 or more Assigned VariablesLists. But only the FactorsForm has an option value (is bound), the others Assigned VariablesList do not have their proper option value: their values contribute to the value of the FactorsForm option. In the code, each control that is bound to an option value has a BoundControl object (some controls like Available VariablesList do not have a BoundControl as their value is not set in an option).

The error was that the Assigned VariablesList inside a FactorsForm had still a BoundControl object, and this lead to some confusion in the code.

What happened in Linear Regression is a bit tricky: the "model 1" has the assignAvailableVariablesToList property set to true, which means that when new variables are set in the Available VariablesList, these variables should be automatically set in the "model 1" VariablesList. But when this analysis is initiailized (either by duplicating the analysis, or by loading a JASP file containing a Linear Regression analysis), all controls are initialized when they are created: the "model 1' control is initialized with a null value (as it does not have its own value). In this particular case (assignAvailableVariablesToList is true and no value is given), as there might be default values in the Available VariablesList, which must be set in the Assigned VariablesList (this is for example the case in the ModelTerms of the Repeated Measures ANOVA), this default values are also set in the Assigned VariablesList (line 77 of VariablesListBase.cpp)
This is solved by just testing whether the control has a bound value
Also the BoundControl objects should not be created when the control has no bound value.

author: Timo Kluck <tkluck@infty.nl>
commit message:
Build against any R for OSX

The most important changes are:

 - use C++11 for ALL THE THINGS. This is the reason why boost > 1.54 was unhappy. ALL THE THINGS includes RInside, so we build it with

    R CMD install --configure-args="CFLAGS=--std=c++11" RInside<version>.tar.gz

 - Distinguish between R_FRAMEWORK and R_HOME for OS X

 - Boost usually installs to /usr/local/include (homebrew does that, for
   example), but that's not in the standard search path for how qmake calls
   clang++ (????). So we need to support passing a BOOST variable to the
   configure script. Default to ../boost_1_54_0 for compatibility with what
   the build documentation says.

commit message:
Beter handling of Selection. mouse click and right-click behaviour on the Data view (#5134)

* Beter handling of Selection. mouse click and right-click behaviour on the Data view

In the DataView, different issues have been solved:
. Select a cell, right click on another cell: the selected cell should be unselected, and the pop-up menu should appear
. Select some cells, right-click on one of these cells: the selected cells should stay selected, and the pop-uo menu shoulp appear. A right-click on an unselected cell should unselect the selected cells, select the new cell, and the pop-up menu should appear. A simple click (on a selected cell or not) unselect the other cells, and select the current cell, and this cell gets the focus.
. Click on a row header: the whole row should be selected. Click on one cell (selected or not), the row is unselected, only the current cell is selected and has the focus. Right click on a selected cell: the row stays selected, and a pop-up menu appears on the clicked cell. Right -click on a unselected cell, the row is unselected and a pop-up menu appears on the clicked cell.
. Click on a row header and shift-click on another row header: all the rows between the 2 rows shoudl be selected. Same behaviour as with only one row selected.. If delete row is selected from the pop-up menu or from the ribbon menu: all the selected rows should be removed.
. Same behaviour with column header

author: Joris Goosen <Joris@JorisGoosen.nl>
commit message:
remove WAL from sqlite to avoid bugs

also log how long it took to load or synch a file

Why remove WAL?
It was faster yes, but often the engine would not have the up-to-date info and then crash.
Adding walcheckpoints all over the place didnt seem to help

the slowdown is a bit noticeable with >3000k columns, but given that we didnt support them before shouldnt be a big problem.

For speed comparisons:

        WAL     NO-WAL
3KC      4s        10s
10KC    28s        54s
200KR   30s        30s
1MR    146s       147s
1KR5KC 347s       356s

Where the "R" sets have 2 columns and the "C" sets have a single row.
As can be seen, there *is* a delay for 1K cols and above, but it seems constant.
And any fixes for the synching-db problem with the engine most likely includes adding new delays...
So lets just turn it off

author: bruno boutin <b.boutin@uva.nl>
commit message:
Initialize controls only if their dependencies are already initialized (#5371)

* Initialize controls only if their dependencies are already initialized

* Remove ugly code

The Initialization of the available variablesList was quite ugly: a long comment in the bindTo method of the AnalysisForm object tried to explain how this initialization was done, but with this PR, I try to do it in the 'right way'.
The available VariablesLists have no bound value (they don't give values for the analysis), but they must be initialized. For this, as the setInitialized is called even for these controls, just override this method in VaraibelListBase, so that:
. when it has an avalable list model, then it should get its values from its sources.
. when it has an assigned list model, handle the particular case when the addAvailableVariablesToAssigned prperty is true, and it is initialized with no value, then it should take the values of its available list model (which might have default values).

* add context object "this" for lambda to avoid random crashes in the future

Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-issues/issues/3656

* Dont loop through the labels to avoid collisions

Instead a map is used to know what labels have what original value and display text, they are uniquely defined by this.
Before was naively looping through the labels to check and merge them in a preceding step.
Same goes for intsId, it is simply tracked now instead of found by looping.

Both loops are now lookups at the cost of a little maintenance

Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-issues/issues/2910 (extremely slow loading of semibig text file)

* Add yet another map...

Looping through the labels to find the Non-missing ones slows down the application quite a bit with bigger datasets.
so instead make a mapping in labelsTempCount() that we can easily query.

author: bruno boutin <b.boutin@uva.nl>
commit message:
Setting an interface font makes data disappears

. The main problem was that when the interface font is changed, it
should call (like for uiScale change) the viewPort change slot of the
DataSetView
. The DropDown settings in PrefsUI.qml were confusing: the value was
set to be the preferencesModel.interfaceFont, but onValueChanged signal
sets the preferencesModel.interfaceFont to value.
. The value should not be directly set in a DropDown, only the
currentIndex. If no currentIndex is known, then a new property is made
‘startValue’ that sets internally the right currentIndex.
. Moreover, when an item is being initialised, the properties are
changed from empty to the specified value. So onValueChanged is called
twice (empty and specified value), without real interaction with the
user. These calls should be avoided, so the property ‘initialized’ has
been added, and is set to true only when the control is fully
initialised, and can be used to avoid these extra onValueChanged calls.
. Remove obsolete isDirectModel property in ComboBox

commit message:
The value of a control initilaized by a file should not change via binding

Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-test-release/issues/1760

If a value of a control is set with a binding in QML (for example a DoubleField is set per default by the number of variables selected by the user), this value can be changed by the user self to another value. If this value is saved in a JASP file, when reading the file, JASP must prevent the binding to overwrite the value.
This mechanism exists already via the _resetBindingValue JASPControl function. But in a case of an upgrade, an option that did not exist in a previous version, may have a default value set via a binding. In this particular case, the value should not be reset.

commit message:
When Tab name changes, the bound value should be first updated

Fixes https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-test-release/issues/1822

When the name of a tab is changed, the nameChangedHandler of the ComponentsListBase is called, which calls the changeTerm method of its model. But as the name of a tab is also the key value of the bound value, this value must be first changed in the bound value so that the other control values of the tab can be found.

author: boutinb <b.boutin@uva.nl>
commit message:
Beter handling of Selection. mouse click and right-click behaviour on the Data view

In the DataView, different issues have been solved:
. Select a cell, right click on another cell: the selected cell should be unselected, and the pop-up menu should appear
. Select some cells, right-click on one of these cells: the selected cells should stay selected, and the pop-uo menu shoulp appear. A right-click on an unselected cell should unselect the selected cells, select the new cell, and the pop-up menu should appear. A simple click (on a selected cell or not) unselect the other cells, and select the current cell, and this cell gets the focus.
. Click on a row header: the whole row should be selected. Click on one cell (selected or not), the row is unselected, only the current cell is selected and has the focus. Right click on a selected cell: the row stays selected, and a pop-up menu appears on the clicked cell. Right -click on a unselected cell, the row is unselected and a pop-up menu appears on the clicked cell.
. Click on a row header and shift-click on another row header: all the rows between the 2 rows shoudl be selected. Same behaviour as with only one row selected.. If delete row is selected from the pop-up menu or from the ribbon menu: all the selected rows should be removed.
. Same behaviour with column header

author: AlexanderLyNL <Alexander.Ly.NL@gmail.com>
commit message:
Added dormant replication BF for the correlation, cleaned out code

Added:
- isTryError in common
- .bfPearsonCorrelation, a wrapper around .bfCorrieKernel that loops
over the methods automatically
- Rewrote .bfCorrieKernel. The method numbers in .bfCorrieKernel now
refer to 1. exact likelihood, 2. jeffreysApprox likelihood, 3.
Savage-Dickey beta approximation to the likelihood, 4. Marsman sampler,
5. Jeffreys asymptotic approximation, 6. Error. Thus, numerical is
swapped for Savage-Dickey beta approximation
- .bfHypergeo is a wrapper for method 1 and 2. Automatically switches
from hypergeometric result to numerical integration whenever the
two-sided bf10 > 10^(hyperGeoOverFlowThreshold)
- Added .bfCorrieRepJosine, which is not activated in the UI.
.bfCorrieRepJosine takes on the role of .bfCorrieKernel for replication
(summary stats) data.

Changed (mostly style changes):
- camelCases: Changed variable.names to variableNames to adhere to the
style guide
- all.bfs to bfObject
- some.r to obsR
- .jeffreysApproxH function to . hJeffreysApprox
- changed return(NaN) to return(NA) in .bf10Exact - though I had some
semantical reasons to use NAN instead NA, but this can be solved by
identifying NULL to not calculated yet
- changed function call by name rather than position
- added name spaces to some functions calls, such
- removed base name space for is.infinite

Removed:
- Removed .bf10Numerical, it isn’t used anyways, but hard coded in
